title: Discovery of Novel Inhibitors for WD Repeat-Containing Protein 5 (WDR5)-MYC Protein-Protein Interaction.
authors: Sun, Wei; Yu, Huaxing; Ye, Jiuyong; Qin, Luoheng; Wang, Linli; Yan, Hailu; Zhang, Zhimin; Aliper, Alex; Ren, Feng; Ding, Xiao; Zhavoronkov, Alex; Liu, Dongzhou
one_liner_zh: 该文研究WDR5-MYC蛋白-蛋白相互作用抑制剂发现，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI/物理模拟方法用于结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: The WD Repeat-Containing Protein 5 (WDR5) and MYC interaction is crucial for MYC-mediated oncogenesis, yet effective therapeutic intervention remains challenging due to the limited efficacy of current treatments targeting WDR5. Herein, we report the discovery of novel WDR5-MYC protein-protein interaction (PPI) inhibitors with improved potency and drug-like properties by utilizing a generative chemistry platform along with a physics-model-based tool AlChemistry. Initially, three hits were identified with reasonable binding affinity for WDR5, and further refinement through detailed structural analysis led to the discovery of sub-micromolar affinity compounds (compound 9c-1), which are > 30-fold better than reported inhibitors. These findings provide a promising starting point for targeting the WDR5-MYC interaction in MYC-driven cancers.
abstract_zh: WD重复包含蛋白5（WDR5）与MYC之间的相互作用对MYC介导的肿瘤发生至关重要，然而，由于当前针对WDR5的治疗方法疗效有限，有效的治疗干预仍具挑战性。在此，我们报告了利用生成化学平台及基于物理模型的工具AlChemistry，发现了新型WDR5-MYC蛋白-蛋白相互作用（PPI）抑制剂，其具有更高的效力和类药性质。最初，我们鉴定出三个对WDR5具有合理结合亲和力的命中化合物，通过详细的结构分析进一步优化，发现了亚微摩尔亲和力化合物（化合物9c-1），其效力比已报道的抑制剂高出30倍以上。这些发现为在MYC驱动的癌症中靶向WDR5-MYC相互作用提供了一个有前景的起点。
